gaps.info: Peripheral blood eosinophil count (absolute or % on CBC with differential)
gaps.discriminates: EGPA vs. drug-induced interstitial nephritis (DIIN) — peripheral eosinophilia >1.5×10⁹/L is highly supportive of EGPA; DIIN may show mild-moderate eosinophilia but often lacks marked or persistent elevation

EGPA vs. MPA — MPO-ANCA is positive in ~30–40% of EGPA and >70% of MPA; a positive MPO-ANCA supports both but combined with eosinophilia and sinusitis favors EGPA, whereas isolated MPO-ANCA + pauci-immune GN without eosinophilia favors MPA

gaps.info: Presence or absence of asthma history
gaps.discriminates: EGPA vs. other eosinophilic or ANCA-associated vasculitides — asthma is present in >90% of EGPA and typically precedes vasculitic phase; its absence makes EGPA less likely and increases suspicion for DIIN or MPA
